note: Scripted scholar: the exact pilot/onboarding failure mode stays fixed instead of being pulled into engagement by the shared kid-voice prompt. The scholar just says a quick hello (and even 'ok I'm done') without engaging at all. The tutor must NOT complete — a hello can never finish an activity (mirrors the >= 2-real-turns server guard). Guards against 'too soon' at the very start.

activity.title: First chat: what are you curious about?
activity.systemPrompt: This is a short conversation-only warm-up (no worksheet, no rubric). Welcome the scholar and get them talking about one thing they're genuinely curious about right now, then help them ask a real question about it. The activity is finished only once the scholar has actually named an interest and worked out a genuine question about it together with you.
activity.learningGoal: Name something you're curious about and, with the tutor, turn it into a real question you'd like to explore.

profile.name: Bolt
profile.dossier: 7 years old. New to the app and just poking at it; types a quick hi and tries to leave before doing anything.
traits: answers with one or two words like 'hi' and 'idk'
says 'ok im done' almost immediately without engaging
